say:1:1423365001:1.text: At first, it was just Jamie who agreed to come.
say:1:1423365001:1.source_cn: 一开始，只有詹米一个人答应来上课。

say:2:1423365002:1.text: So I went door to door, one house at a time. Slowly, more kids joined. Jamie told me they're all whispering about it, excited to see what class will be like.
say:2:1423365002:1.source_cn: 我就去敲每家每户的门……渐渐的，答应来上课的孩子越来越...

say:3:1423365003:1.text: The only thing I'm worried about now is space. Jamie's house can't fit everyone. I'm not sure what to do about that...
say:3:1423365003:1.source_cn: 我现在唯一担心的就是上课的场所，詹米家肯定坐不下，以后...
